posts.title: Roundup: September 2026 deliveries by major Chinese automakers
posts.summary:
Leapmotor and Zeekr set fresh records, while Xiaomi tops 40,000 deliveries to reach its highest monthly level this year.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD dominated the market with 463,561 sales in September, marking its fifth consecutive month of year-on-year growth and a return to quarterly growth.
Leapmotor and Zeekr achieved record-breaking delivery figures, while Xiaomi surpassed the 40,000-unit milestone for the first time this year.
Major EV players Nio and Xpeng successfully met their third-quarter delivery guidance, signaling stabilization in their respective growth trajectories.
Huawei's HIMA and Li Auto faced continued headwinds, both recording year-on-year declines in September as competitive pressures intensify.

posts.title: BYD September sales rise 16.98% to 463,561, hitting new high for 2026
posts.summary:
BYD posted its fifth consecutive month of year-on-year NEV sales growth and seventh consecutive month of sequential growth.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD achieved a new 2026 monthly high of 463,561 NEV sales, reflecting a 16.98% year-on-year increase.
The company recorded 1,323,065 NEV sales in the third quarter, marking a return to quarterly year-on-year growth after four consecutive quarters of decline.
Passenger battery electric vehicle (BEV) sales reached a record 273,143 units, contributing to a positive cumulative growth trend for the first nine months of the year.

posts.title: Geely September sales rise 7% to 2026 high as record export streak ends
posts.summary:
Geely Auto exported 106,685 vehicles in September, up 162% year-on-year but down 3% from August, ending 8 consecutive months of record exports.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Geely Auto achieved its highest monthly sales of 2026 in September with 292,168 units, a 6.97% increase year-on-year.
The company's export streak ended after eight months of record-breaking growth, with September exports falling 3% sequentially to 106,685 units.
Domestic sales decline eased to 20% year-on-year, representing the smallest contraction for the company since February.

posts.title: US Executive Order On Energy Grid Supply Chain Security
posts.summary:
Compliance with trade restrictions is no longer about proving where a device was built, but about how the product works.
The post US Executive Order On Energy Grid Supply Chain Security appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: The August 2026 executive order mandates strict security vetting for equipment used in U.S. electric grid infrastructure operating at 69 kilovolts or higher, including transformers, inverters, and SCADA software.

Compliance requirements have shifted from simple country-of-origin labeling to deep-tier supply chain transparency, requiring manufacturers to prove the provenance of sub-components like chips and internal firmware.
The Department of Energy is expected to release specific implementing rules by December 24, 2026, which may include prohibited-entity lists or pre-qualified vendor white lists.
While the order targets foreign adversaries, U.S. and Western manufacturers are also at risk if their supply chains rely on critical components sourced from restricted jurisdictions.
Utilities are already pausing procurement and demanding rigorous provenance documentation, signaling significant near-term disruption for vendors with complex, globalized supply chains.

posts.title: The Download: AI “mind-reading” and creative uses for small batteries
posts.summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. An AI “mind-reading” tool can reconstruct what you’re looking at based on a brain scan A new AI tool can guess what you’re looking at just by analyzing your brain scans—and…
bullets: The Pentagon has appointed Elon Musk to co-lead 'Project Meridian,' a strategic initiative focused on analyzing future warfare across domains ranging from underground to space.
Researchers have developed an AI tool capable of reconstructing visual imagery from human brain scans with high precision, raising significant neuroethical concerns regarding mental privacy.
Startups are bypassing regulatory hurdles for utility-scale energy storage by deploying small-scale, distributed battery systems in consumer applications like induction stoves and food carts.
The integration of consumer-focused battery units offers a decentralized approach to grid resilience and pollution reduction, potentially aggregating into substantial capacity as costs decline.
